name: Gift Sets (Kraft)
description: A custom packaged gift set box with a choice of three or six items. It is made from eco-friendly kraft corrugated material, with a custom printed tray or tissue paper and a custom printed label to seal the box. The gift box can also be used as a mailer.

features: Bleeds allowed on all sides of the label and tray
materials: Package: gift box (200# E-flute kraft corrugated), custom gloss label, custom tray (16pt cover stock) or tissue paper
printing: Digital: full color on the label and tray

thumbnail.alt: Two open kraft gift boxes, a three-pack of labeled glass jars and a six-pack of labeled tins.
